author: Spartemex
body:
Hello everyone! Lately, for the past couple of weeks, I have been working to put together a build server for all of you :) Thanks to some help from resepignev and the Map Devs for helping me test stuff out, it is ready!

This is a public server, although we do have a whitelist enabled, so people won't come in and grief your maps.

Some advantages:
  • Whitelist & Application process, so not just anyone can join.
  • Active Admins: both me and resepignev will be keeping an eye on the server. We will be able to provide download links in about 48 hours from the time you request them, and we can try to resolve any issues that are brought to our attention.
  • Experienced Staff: Most of the staff on the server are MapDevs, so if you ever have any questions, feel free to ask! They are more than happy to help.
  • 1.7: Since Avicus is a combo 1.7 and 1.8 server right now, if you build a map on a 1.8 server, when you try to import it into the Avicus repo, all the chests will be empty. I have checked with the mapdevs, and importing from my server works just fine.
  • Avicus Exclusive: This server is only open to members of the Avicus Network! Anyone on there will most likely be able to help you out with gameplay suggestions.
  • Tri-Monthly World Cleanouts: Every three months, I will purge the hard drives of the server of old unused worlds to keep the server in tip-top shape. I will warn you guys well ahead of time, and give you a form to save maps from being purged.
Plugin List:
  • WorldEdit
  • Voxelsniper
  • Multiverse
  • PermissionsEx
  • LogBlock
  • Essentials (ofc)
  • Let me know if you need other plugins!
Hope to see you there, and happy building!

Server Access Form: http://goo.gl/forms/JNk3bQf7ci (Include your skype/email please)!

Map Download Requisition Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XESdPx98c-kRNZTnKK9FqQJ-pTIptj8wwdSYOyqFHI0/viewform?uspI

If you would like to have a file preloaded, upload it to the link below, and let me know that you did so in the "additional comments" section of the application.

Map Preload Upload: http://www.mediafire.com/filedrop/filedrop_hosted.php?drop=d4383888dd721fbadc05a8227e5c4cf8491d1d48160d3ac85f1c2c935f8b5742
